defects.description: Expired compares elapsed time with >= instead of >, so a session exactly ttl old is reported expired though the contract says it is still valid for one more instant.
defects.why_missed: The only test for this exact boundary calls t.Skip behind RUN_BOUNDARY_TESTS, an environment variable this suite never sets, so go test reports ok and the guard never actually runs.
defects.severity_rationale: A session exactly at the TTL boundary is visibly classified as expired on a rare boundary input.

detection_criteria.mechanism: Expired compares elapsed time with >= instead of >, so a session exactly ttl old is reported expired though the contract says it is still valid for one more instant.
detection_criteria.proof: Show one input or state where the output contradicts expected_behavior.
